explanation: This function is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because user_input is concatenated directly into os.system('echo ' + user_input). Crafted input containing shell metacharacters could execute arbitrary OS commands. The repair avoids shell execution by using subprocess.run() with shell=False, but relies on shlex.split('echo ' + user_input) instead of ['echo', user_input], allowing argument splitting and raising ValueError on unbalanced quotes.
